strings: Sleepily, m_c thanks r_c for the pain relief. It feels like moons since {PRONOUN/m_c/subject}{VERB/m_c/'re/'s} been able to have a good rest without the awful pain that's been so intense lately.
m_c's joint pain is worse than usual this moon, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/find/finds} {PRONOUN/m_c/self} barely able to get up out of {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} nest.
